
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/roseAT/p/19890975" title="发布于 2026-04-19 15:05">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">分享一下笔者的 Mac 装机必备软件</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        分享一下笔者的 Mac 装机必备软件
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p><em>碎碎念...</em></p>
<p>本周上班干活的时候，笔记本屏幕直接黑了 GG。最开始我还以为是没电了，结果插上电，重启大法试了一下，屏幕也就只会亮1s。</p>
<p>不过外接显示器能正常用，庆幸核心没搞坏，那 8 成是屏幕相关的问题了，就拿去维修（2周左右要），换了一台旧电脑临时用一下。（公司电脑 💻 (#<sup>.</sup>#)）</p>
<p>又得从头来一遍"装机"，趁此机会搞个清单，下次就不用对着旧电脑搞了。</p>
<p><em>看合集直接划到最后😋</em></p>
<h2 id="装机必备">装机必备</h2>
<h3 id="1-itsycal"><a href="https://github.com/sfsam/Itsycal/tree/master" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">1. Itsycal</a></h3>
<p>状态栏 日历/时间 小组件。平时排期就拿这个看时间。</p>
<p>还有复古的整点报时。</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.upyun.sugarat.top/mdImg/sugar/8a5d8fd5d406a55c653e6eb4f829a769" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="2-bartender"><a href="https://www.macbartender.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">2. Bartender</a></h3>
<p>状态栏图标管理工具。</p>
<p>Mac 软件装多了，顶部状态栏里 各种杂七杂八的软件图标，有些不会用到，但占用着很烦。</p>
<p>用这个能方便的管理哪些展示哪些不展示。</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.upyun.sugarat.top/mdImg/sugar/70e47c81c180e6f15c99b175fc26af15" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><em>都给我去装上 (</em><sup>▽</sup><em>)！</em></p>
<h3 id="3-snipaste"><a href="https://www.snipaste.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">3. Snipaste</a></h3>
<p>简单但强大的截图工具，用了都说好!</p>
<p>支持剪贴板内容转图，截图钉在屏幕上，截图历史回溯，这几个我最常用的功能，。</p>
<h3 id="4-alfred"><a href="https://www.alfredapp.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">4. Alfred</a></h3>
<p>比较老牌的一个聚合工具平台。</p>
<p>笔者主要就用它内置的 剪贴板 功能，足够简洁，切性能比试用过的其它的专门的剪贴板软件要好。</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.upyun.sugarat.top/mdImg/sugar/172879668059f94b771658afbb35280b" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="5-arc"><a href="https://arc.net/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">5. Arc</a></h3>
<p>Arc 浏览器，用习惯了非常方便，支持多端数据同步（不支持插件），支持多身份的设计。竖向的标签排列。</p>
<p><em>只可惜主创团队，现在不更新功能了，只更新 Chrome 内核版本，转向</em> <em><a href="https://www.diabrowser.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Dia</a></em> <em>的 AI 浏览器了</em></p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.upyun.sugarat.top/mdImg/sugar/dcea899d656fc5ce89fc5b465011548b" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><em>不过同事推荐说公司出的这个 AI浏览器也挺好用</em> <em><a href="https://www.tabbitbrowser.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Tabbit 浏览器</a>，感兴趣的可以试试</em></p>
<h3 id="6-betterdisplay"><a href="https://github.com/waydabber/BetterDisplay" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">6. BetterDisplay</a></h3>
<p>调节显示器亮度，分辨率等非常方便。</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.upyun.sugarat.top/mdImg/sugar/bcd85ffb9ecf40f2b22774dd26e5a700" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="7-tencent-lemon"><a href="https://lemon.qq.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">7. Tencent Lemon</a></h3>
<p>日常拿来清理一下垃圾。不然过几天 500G 的盘又满了。</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.upyun.sugarat.top/mdImg/sugar/b9de37ea679aa0091cc2f613cdc755a3" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="办公搭子">办公搭子</h2>
<h3 id="1-bongocat"><a href="https://github.com/ayangweb/BongoCat" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">1. BongoCat</a></h3>
<p>”可爱互动的桌面宠物应用“，基于 Tauri 制作，支持三端！</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.upyun.sugarat.top/mdImg/sugar/a33bd0ca6f9096d2ff6236ec75ce1c56" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>鼠标和键盘的动作，猫猫都会同步。</p>
<p><em>赶紧装上，敲键盘又多了一点乐趣</em></p>
<h3 id="2-healthtick"><a href="https://github.com/lifedever/health-tick-release?tab=readme-ov-file" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">2. HealthTick</a></h3>
<p>久坐提醒工具。</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.upyun.sugarat.top/mdImg/sugar/8d189e3251c219b54c3a78869b688bd3" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="3-shui"><a href="https://github.com/rock-zhang/Shui" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">3. Shui</a></h3>
<p>全屏展示的提醒喝水的软件！。</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.upyun.sugarat.top/mdImg/sugar/8347fa9399d80a2a9fc0224473c840fa" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><em>上班安排起来，给尿喝清亮！</em></p>
<h3 id="4-drawio"><a href="https://www.drawio.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">4. drawio</a></h3>
<p>画图神器，工作中拿来画流程图架构图必备。</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.upyun.sugarat.top/mdImg/sugar/a61c93b8ffe494fdc764a3845269d903" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="5-kap"><a href="https://getkap.co/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">5. Kap</a></h3>
<p>录屏软件，支持导出多种常用格式，支持基础的编辑。</p>
<p>使用起来非常方便，软件也是开源<a href="https://github.com/wulkano/kap" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">github:kap</a>的。</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.upyun.sugarat.top/mdImg/sugar/d603d42200fc0873041c06e85adfc471" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="6-easydict"><a href="https://github.com/tisfeng/Easydict" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">6. Easydict</a></h3>
<p>聚合翻译软件，速度也快，支持快捷唤起。</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.upyun.sugarat.top/mdImg/sugar/e9cfbbad79f088fc88343b597291130f" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="开发相关">开发相关</h2>
<h3 id="1-warp"><a href="https://www.warp.dev/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">1. Warp</a></h3>
<p>强大又美观的终端工具，内置 AI 能力集成！</p>
<p>相较于传统的终端工具，其更加智能，编辑指令也非常方便。</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.upyun.sugarat.top/mdImg/sugar/7949dc0d26c1e130e3227389bb889f72" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="2-kiro-cli"><a href="https://kiro.dev/downloads/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">2. Kiro CLI</a></h3>
<p>笔者主要用这个终端输入提示的功能。</p>
<p><em>这个功能最早是在 Fig 里，后来被亚马逊收购了。</em></p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.upyun.sugarat.top/mdImg/sugar/abdec3aac898108e570e6ee0234c83a8" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="3-easydevo"><a href="https://easydevo.boringboring.design/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">3. EasyDevo</a></h3>
<p>Mac垃圾清理 &amp; 系统监控软件，开发者友好。</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: center">系统监控</th>
<th style="text-align: center">node_modules 清理</th>
<th style="text-align: center">项目统计</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center"><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img.cdn.sugarat.top/mdImg/sugar/383755a2089ec6aca9b7b469b8e02de9" class="lazyload"></td>
<td style="text-align: center"><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img.cdn.sugarat.top/mdImg/sugar/a05902a5431608eae5bb27b1747e929b" class="lazyload"></td>
<td style="text-align: center"><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img.cdn.sugarat.top/mdImg/sugar/fb69bbdfc27ead1f58f34dd530faea71" class="lazyload"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center"><br></td>
<td style="text-align: center"><br></td>
<td style="text-align: center"><br></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="4-utools"><a href="https://www.u-tools.cn/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">4. uTools</a></h3>
<p>聚合工具平台，笔者主要装了一些开发相关的插件。</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.upyun.sugarat.top/mdImg/sugar/8a8ee6c74057295376920b45b5177e31" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="5-whistle-client"><a href="https://github.com/avwo/whistle-client" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">5. Whistle Client</a></h3>
<p>代理调试抓包工具！</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.upyun.sugarat.top/mdImg/sugar/4d0d12a35e6f98ef7df328fdc2cae1c9" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="6-ide">6. IDE</h3>
<p>笔者就常用 <a href="https://www.trae.ai/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">TRAE</a> 和 <a href="https://cursor.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Cursor</a>，自打AI大爆发以来，VS Code 直接不装了。</p>
<h2 id="终端指令">终端指令</h2>
<h3 id="1-fnm"><a href="https://github.com/Schniz/fnm" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">1. fnm</a></h3>
<p>Node 版本管理工具！</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.upyun.sugarat.top/mdImg/sugar/fdb3b5c16b765a6ef94390d5fc0cd0fc" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="2-zoxide"><a href="https://github.com/ajeetdsouza/zoxide" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">2. zoxide</a></h3>
<p>快速切换目录的工具！</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.upyun.sugarat.top/mdImg/sugar/8e29d18b64989826972950c7cb6eb534" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="3-yrm"><a href="https://github.com/i5ting/yrm" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">3. yrm</a></h3>
<p>npm 镜像源管理。</p>
<pre><code class="language-sh">yrm ls

* npm ---- https://registry.npmjs.org/
  cnpm --- http://r.cnpmjs.org/
  taobao - https://registry.npmmirror.com/
  nj ----- https://registry.nodejitsu.com/
  rednpm - http://registry.mirror.cqupt.edu.cn/
  npmMirror  https://skimdb.npmjs.com/registry/
  edunpm - http://registry.enpmjs.org/
  yarn --- https://registry.yarnpkg.com
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-ni"><a href="https://github.com/antfu-collective/ni" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">4. ni</a></h3>
<pre><code class="language-sh">npm i -g @antfu/ni
</code></pre>
<p>常用的 <code>ni</code> 装依赖，<code>nr</code> 运行 npm 指令。</p>
<h3 id="5-killport"><a href="https://github.com/jkfran/killport" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">5. killport</a></h3>
<p>使用 killport 可以一步到位，直接杀死占用端口的进程</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img.cdn.sugarat.top/mdImg/MTY5MDAzNTgwNzI0NQ==690035807245" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="其它推荐">其它推荐</h2>
<h3 id="1-marta"><a href="https://marta.sh/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">1. Marta</a></h3>
<p>文件管理软件，可以拿来替代系统默认的 Finder。支持双栏展示，移动和整理文件的时候也比较方便。</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.upyun.sugarat.top/mdImg/sugar/f445eb3f7eb8e2382dfbb8e9fb7665e5" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="2-localsend"><a href="https://localsend.org/#/download" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">2. LocalSend</a></h3>
<p>多设备之间相互传输文件。足够简单且好用。</p>
<p><img alt="" loading="lazy" data-src="https://cdn.upyun.sugarat.top/mdImg/sugar/37e1d5f3dff31821435a54160d4e51da" class="lazyload"></p>
